description.value: Glenburn Soda Fountain & Confectionery is a classic, hand-crafted ice cream shop that opened in March 2013 in the Burnaby Heights neighbourhood, owned and operated by local residents Ron and Roberta LaQuaglia. It serves a rotating menu of creative sundaes, milkshakes, malts, banana splits, and specialty treats alongside candy and nostalgic confectionery. A well-established community favourite on Hastings Street, it also offers event catering and dairy-free vegan options.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 10m; stands (2 spaces) at 33m; stands (2 spaces) at 78m; stands (2 spaces) at 83m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (updated May 17, 2026) confirms the business is open with current hours, actively hiring, and operating at 4090 Hastings Street, Burnaby. Phone, address, and email all match OSM tags exactly. OSM opening hours differ from the website (OSM shows Wed/Thu starting at 18:00, website shows 15:00 Tuesday–Thursday; OSM omits Tuesday entirely), so the OSM hours appear stale — flagged in concerns. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website ('This menu is offered for pickup and takeout only'); vegan and dairy-free options are confirmed by multiple menu references ('completely vegan sundae', 'Dairy Free Sundae listing'); no evidence found for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenities.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (We,Th 18:00-21:00; Fr 18:00-22:00; Sa 15:00-22:00; Su 15:00-22:00) appears stale: website (updated May 17, 2026) shows Tuesday–Thursday 15:00–21:00, Friday–Saturday 15:00–22:00, Sunday 15:00–21:00, Monday closed. Tuesday is missing entirely from the OSM tag. OSM hours should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating ice cream parlour confirmed open via a website updated May 2026 with current hours and active job postings. A natural stop for touring cyclists on Hastings Street.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website references a 'completely vegan sundae' and a dedicated 'Dairy Free Sundae listing'; notes 'most of our ice cream does not contain gluten ingredients' though gluten ingredients are present in-store
